privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This notice explains how personal data is processed when using the RATIO Smart Innovations website and submitting an inquiry through the contact form, in accordance with Article 13 of the GDPR.

sections.title: Data controller
paragraphs: The controller of personal data is Krzysztof Szczepański, operating under the RATIO Smart Innovations brand, Polish Tax ID 8971950553, address: Stanisława Leszczyńskiego 4/77, 50-078 Wrocław, Poland.
For matters concerning personal data, contact kontakt@ratiosmart.pl or call +48 576 412 390. The controller has not appointed a data protection officer.

sections.title: Data processed
items: Data entered in the form: full name, email address, optional phone number, selected service type and message content.
Technical data necessary for operation and security, such as IP address, request time and diagnostic error information.

sections.title: Purposes and legal bases
items: Handling the inquiry and taking steps at the data subject’s request before entering into a contract — Article 6(1)(b) GDPR.
Managing correspondence, ensuring continuity of communication and establishing or defending claims — the controller’s legitimate interests, Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.
Protecting the website, preventing abuse and diagnosing errors — the controller’s legitimate interests, Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.
Compliance with legal obligations arising in connection with an inquiry or contract — Article 6(1)(c) GDPR.

sections.title: Recipients
paragraphs: Data may be entrusted to providers of hosting, email and SMTP services, IT maintenance, security and error monitoring, solely to the extent necessary to provide those services. Data may also be disclosed to public authorities where required by law.

sections.title: Transfers outside the EEA
paragraphs: Contact-form content is delivered to the controller’s mailbox and is not intentionally transferred outside the European Economic Area. The website uses Sentry for error diagnostics. Default user-identifying data is disabled, and email addresses and phone numbers are removed from messages before transmission.

Where a technical provider allows access from a third country, the transfer is based on an appropriate mechanism under Articles 45 or 46 GDPR, including an adequacy decision or Standard Contractual Clauses. Information about the safeguards used can be obtained from the controller.

sections.title: Retention
items: Inquiry data is retained for the time necessary to reply and manage subsequent correspondence.
If the inquiry leads to a contract, data may be retained for the contract term and until applicable limitation periods and statutory obligations expire.
Technical data used to limit abuse is retained briefly, while diagnostic information is retained for the period defined in the error-monitoring service configuration.

sections.title: Your rights
items: The right to access personal data and receive a copy.
The right to rectification, erasure or restriction of processing.
The right to data portability where provided by the GDPR.
The right to object to processing based on the controller’s legitimate interests.
The right to lodge a complaint with the President of the Polish Personal Data Protection Office.

sections.title: Voluntary provision and automated decisions
paragraphs: Providing data is voluntary. However, full name, email address, service type, message and confirmation that this notice has been read are necessary to submit and handle an inquiry. A phone number is optional.
Data is not used for automated decision-making or profiling.

sections.title: Cookies and technical data
paragraphs: The website does not use marketing or analytics cookies. Contact-form safeguards include a short-term request limit and an anti-spam field. Sentry diagnostics operate with default personal data disabled and additional removal of contact details from error reports.

sections.title: Contact and complaints
paragraphs: Data-related requests may be sent to kontakt@ratiosmart.pl. Complaints may be lodged with the President of the Polish Personal Data Protection Office, Stanisława Moniuszki 1A, 00-014 Warsaw, Poland, using the channels listed at uodo.gov.pl.
